topics.name: Constrained generative molecular and structural design
topics.summary: Generative search is guided by pharmacological or physical constraints to redesign compounds, assemble protein nanostructures, and build composite layouts. The shared approach distributes expensive computation while using validity checks or external evidence to improve feasible candidates.

topics.name: Robotic manipulation and contact-aware control
topics.summary: Manipulation policies combine vision-language priors with tactile, proprioceptive, predictive, or residual feedback to handle contact, payload changes, and disturbances. Across hands, arms, and long-horizon tasks, feedback-conditioned action representations improve recovery and transfer.

topics.name: Autonomous driving planning and control
topics.summary: Planning and control methods combine learned behavior selection with search, trajectory refinement, or feedback control. Occlusions, speed changes, vehicle uncertainty, and closed-loop tracking are recurring evaluation stresses.

topics.name: Embodied robotics, perception, and assistance
topics.summary: Embodied systems use compact 3D or semantic representations, modular perception-to-control stacks, and interactive calibration to connect sensing with action. Applications range from drones and manipulation to device calibration, rehabilitation, assistive wearables, and expressive robot behavior.

topics.name: Human activity recognition and privacy-aware sensing
topics.summary: Activity recognition systems address environmental, client, and privacy variation using WiFi, inertial, skeleton, and CCTV signals. Temporal consistency, selective transfer, relational distillation, and federated personalization improve recognition of falls and other safety-relevant behavior.

topics.name: Physics-informed robot control
topics.summary: Controllers combine learned policies with differentiable dynamics, biological motion principles, or trajectory priors to manage model mismatch and disturbances. Underwater vehicles, humanoids, and multi-robot formations benefit from incorporating mechanics into prediction and feedback.

topics.name: Real-time localization and inertial navigation
topics.summary: Event, magnetic, and inertial sensors support low-latency tracking without relying exclusively on reconstructed frames. Temporal filters, motion-aware representations, and learned correction stages target blur, drift, occlusion, and long-range trajectory stability.

topics.name: Structured multimodal spatial reasoning
topics.summary: Vision-language systems are evaluated on diagrams, RGB-D scenes, room layouts, affordances, and spatial relations. Explicit entities, executable intermediate structures, and geometry-aware prediction improve measurement and positioning beyond direct image-text prompting.

topics.name: Long-horizon agent memory
topics.summary: Agent memory systems organize interaction histories into reusable episodes, behavioral patterns, profiles, or sparse recurrent states. Selective persistence and structured retrieval reduce invalid actions while preserving information needed for later decisions.

topics.name: Coding-agent engineering
topics.summary: Coding agents improve through executable feedback, editable skills, realistic bug curricula, and integrated software benchmarks. Results indicate that grounded reference data helps repair quality, while stateful projects and runtime behavior remain difficult.

topics.name: Tool-using LLM orchestration and serving
topics.summary: Tool-mediated systems coordinate retrieval, calculators, security utilities, parameterized programs, and model calls under production constraints. Scheduling, speculative execution, caching, and demand-aware routing reduce latency and resource use without losing task utility.

topics.name: Evidence-seeking language agents
topics.summary: Language agents acquire missing observations before answering through guided exploration, simulated sources, or verifiable rewards. Multilingual retrieval and clinical reasoning experiments associate explicit evidence gathering with better grounding under incomplete information.

topics.name: Personalized and collaborative AI agents
topics.summary: These systems learn user preferences, share procedural knowledge, or coordinate work across people and agents. Interaction histories, role assignment, linguistic feedback, and delegation mechanisms are used to improve alignment and decision support.

topics.name: Efficient reasoning and optimization for language models
topics.summary: Language-model improvement is allocated selectively: methods weight uncertain reasoning steps or delay unstable tokens, while others compress updates, mix adapters, or reuse retrieved examples. Results trade capability retention against compute, communication, and interference under changing tasks.

topics.name: Reliable and selective LLM inference
topics.summary: Reliability is treated as a decision problem under stochastic outputs and limited computation. Resampling, specialist routing, and abstention identify risky cases, improving the quality-risk balance over single-shot generation.

topics.name: Human-centered LLM assistance
topics.summary: Prompt interfaces, tutoring dialogues, and agentic code review are studied through user outcomes and acceptance behavior. The findings emphasize that explicit specifications and conversational support help only when generated suggestions remain relevant, valid, and aligned with human intent.

topics.name: Agent security, evaluation, and formal oversight
topics.summary: Agent assurance is measured through adversarial configuration tests, end-to-end contests, authorization checks, typed workflows, and threat aggregation. These studies show that local competence is insufficient when tools, multiple agents, or strategic interaction can amplify unsafe behavior.

topics.name: Enterprise AI governance
topics.summary: Enterprise assurance frameworks track identity, provenance, memory, tools, policy, authority, and replayable evidence around model actions. Pre-action controls and observability are presented as necessary complements to answer-quality evaluation for containing operational risk.

topics.name: Video understanding and temporal perception
topics.summary: Video systems model long-range evidence, motion, speakers, captions, anomalies, and camera behavior while reducing redundant computation. Temporal retrieval, patch selection, audio-visual consistency, and synthetic viewpoint variation improve analysis of changing scenes.

topics.name: Multimodal safety and synthetic-media forensics
topics.summary: Multimodal systems are stress-tested with adversarial image-text inputs, concept-conditioned inconsistencies, synthetic videos, and deceptive documents. Cross-model audits and corroborating evidence expose semantic and social failure modes that artifact-only detectors can miss.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving machine learning and data release
topics.summary: Privacy defenses protect biometric templates, training examples, prompts, trajectories, and images through transformation, unlearning, noise calibration, or private generative codes. Evaluations weigh leakage reduction against recognition, navigation, compression, and downstream utility.

topics.name: Audio and speech representation and robustness
topics.summary: Audio models are adapted and audited for clinical speech, child and neurological-disorder corpora, music or bird retrieval, and synthetic-speech detection. Factorized encoders, lightweight fusion, intervention tests, and demographic or content invariance checks expose where frozen representations help or fail.

topics.name: Image restoration
topics.summary: Restoration methods separate corruption from image content using compact priors, state-space processing, reflection-aware modeling, or controllable degradation embeddings. Experiments cover noise, low illumination, reflections, and mixed damage while targeting lower computational cost.

topics.name: Relational and knowledge-graph learning
topics.summary: Relational models recover missing links and transfer information across sparse or evolving entities using shared factors, diffusion embeddings, temporal structure, and ontology connections. Applications include drug interactions, cross-domain knowledge bases, and multimodal field observations.

topics.name: Heterogeneous graph learning
topics.summary: Mixed-type graphs are compressed and embedded with role-aware aggregation, selective feature fusion, and structure-preserving condensation. The methods aim to retain useful relations and improve robustness for large-scale prediction and security applications.

topics.name: Structured record retrieval
topics.summary: Retrieval over tables and multi-source records models schema alignment and cross-source interactions rather than comparing independent global vectors. Structural constraints and learned overlap estimates improve matching quality while avoiding exhaustive pairwise comparison.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and evidence grounding
topics.summary: Retrieval systems combine OCR cleanup, graph or dense indexes, ranker-aware representations, citation checks, and selective escalation. Evaluations emphasize candidate coverage and source authority alongside answer accuracy, latency, and resistance to manipulated evidence.

topics.name: Geometric visual representation learning
topics.summary: Visual models enforce spatial structure through multi-camera correspondence, explicit reflection geometry, region-aware attention, and sparse token interaction. The resulting representations improve depth, registration, occlusion handling, reconstruction efficiency, and boundary fidelity.

topics.name: Test-time adaptation and robust visual prediction
topics.summary: Visual predictors adapt to deployment shifts through low-rank updates, collaborative zeroth-order optimization, uncertainty modeling, and clean-positive supervision. The studies target open-world discovery, adversarial stability, selective behavior, and retention of previously learned categories.

topics.name: Diffusion transformer and efficient generative modeling
topics.summary: Diffusion systems are accelerated through activation analysis, local token reuse, flexible temporal chunking, and redesigned flow or denoising schedules. These techniques preserve detail and diversity while reducing sampling work for image and video generation.

topics.name: Medical and structured-signal diffusion
topics.summary: Generative denoising priors reconstruct structured signals from incomplete visual measurements, including cardiac sequences and pen trajectories. Conditioning, variational regularization, and controlled sampling balance plausible detail with fidelity and runtime.

topics.name: Text-to-image diffusion analysis and bias control
topics.summary: Text-to-image models are examined through prompt, latent, and score sensitivity, then modified with cross-module concept alignment. The work connects internal conditioning behavior with social bias and seeks improvements without sacrificing visual quality.

topics.name: Clinical and scientific image segmentation
topics.summary: Segmentation pipelines use modality-specific cues, domain normalization, and prediction refinement for LiDAR, histopathology, tumors, retinal disease, and polyps. Lightweight correction stages and confidence-aware processing improve boundaries while limiting backbone size and clinical risk.

topics.name: Foundation models for physiological and scientific sensing
topics.summary: Foundation encoders are pretrained on structured sensor measurements and adapted to ECG or EEG diagnosis and lunar imagery. Masking and modality-aware alignment aid transfer, but gains remain sensitive to architecture, site, subject, and measurement mismatch.

topics.name: Cross-subject neuroimaging representation
topics.summary: Neuroimaging resources and decoders reduce subject and age variation through shared reference spaces and anatomical templates. The resulting representations support semantic decoding, cross-person comparison, and longitudinal brain analysis.

topics.name: Geospatial machine learning
topics.summary: Geospatial models align weather, environmental, socioeconomic, and remote-sensing information across scales and locations. Regional forecasting, planetary-grid harmonization, and image-change description illustrate the value of multimodal Earth-system representations.

topics.name: Robust face analysis
topics.summary: Face systems address manipulation and occlusion using evidence-aware benchmarks, periocular features, and adaptive matching thresholds. The studies seek recognition and detection that remain dependable under altered views while retaining inspectable visual cues.

topics.name: Predictive and safe reinforcement learning for industrial control
topics.summary: Learned controllers incorporate short-horizon dynamics, future references, and constraint-aware objectives for physical systems. Helicopter experiments show improved tracking and fewer violations, while hardware transfer remains less reliable than simulation results suggest.

topics.name: Energy-aware reinforcement learning and demand response
topics.summary: Learning methods explore energy-control tradeoffs on physical testbeds and infer how households respond to heat or market incentives. Bayesian search and inverse reinforcement learning capture heterogeneous behavior, including changes that persist after external conditions shift.

topics.name: Robust and recovery-oriented reinforcement learning
topics.summary: These methods strengthen policies against reward changes, dynamics shifts, and autonomous-system failures. Entropy-based objectives receive a robustness interpretation, while causal signals help agents coordinate with recovery procedures instead of following brittle local actions.

topics.name: Autonomous sensing and information gathering
topics.summary: Planning systems select routes and sensors under limits on energy, coverage, geometry, and uncertainty. UAV monitoring and maritime scheduling demonstrate how adaptive information collection can outperform fixed observation policies.

topics.name: Online learning under nonstationarity
topics.summary: Online-learning analyses extend regret guarantees to changing feasible actions, workloads, and data distributions. Blockwise reductions and dynamic bounds provide assurances without assuming a fixed query structure or stationary environment.

topics.name: Ising model inference
topics.summary: Inverse Ising problems are approached with transfer estimation and neural graph reconstruction under limited data or distribution shift. The results stress checking structural relevance and distinguishing genuine recovery from architecture-specific shortcuts.

topics.name: Causal policy learning and recourse
topics.summary: Decision rules are learned for heterogeneous treatment effects, scarce data, subgroup discovery, and personalized intervention. Debiasing, directed search, difficulty analysis, and interactive recourse connect statistical efficiency with actions that remain plausible for individuals.

topics.name: Selective inference and adaptive sampling
topics.summary: Data selection methods use curvature, conformal calibration, and robust error surrogates rather than raw confidence alone. They target compact training sets and high-power treatment-effect discovery while controlling uncertainty and false selections.

topics.name: Transportation modeling under distribution shift
topics.summary: Transportation models separate origin demand from destination preferences and assess whether target populations remain supported by learned structure. Bayesian weighting and choice-potential formulations improve transfer across spatial environments.

topics.name: Information-theoretic representation evaluation
topics.summary: Information estimators are stress-tested across dimensions, marginals, and image dependencies, while graph embeddings are ranked with training-free structural measures. Both lines favor diagnostics matched to the task instead of assuming one universal estimator or representation.

topics.name: Statistical learning with missing data
topics.summary: Probabilistic methods address dependence and missingness through correlation-aware effective sample sizes and low-dimensional geometric structure. The resulting estimators provide uncertainty information without requiring a complete model of every observed relationship.

topics.name: Physics-informed dynamical-system modeling
topics.summary: Learned simulators impose physical structure through uncertainty tracking, reduced-state adaptation, organ-aware fields, or dissipative maps. These priors improve long-range forecasts and safety checks when trajectories drift or observations are sparse.

topics.name: Learning dynamics and local plasticity
topics.summary: Analyses of overparameterized and biologically local networks show that data geometry, temporal order, and local update rules shape learned complexity. The results link implicit optimization bias with synaptic mechanisms that do not require global error signals.

topics.name: Reflected diffusions and stochastic boundary models
topics.summary: Reflected diffusion theory supports domain-preserving generative bridges and analysis of stationary behavior at boundaries. Analytical guarantees, sampling constructions, and counterexamples clarify when reflection yields reliable inference.

topics.name: Neuro-symbolic reasoning and differentiable programs
topics.summary: Symbolic program structure is combined with fuzzy predicates or differentiable execution to reason over vague values and train across many programs. The shared objective is scalable search that retains interpretable program semantics.

topics.name: Representation geometry and model transfer
topics.summary: Model-transfer methods align weights or hidden representations with invariant structure rather than treating coordinates as interchangeable. Dataset-aware embeddings and equivalence-sensitive distillation clarify when geometric similarity reflects transferable capability.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability and behavioral auditing
topics.summary: Weight probes, hidden-state readouts, and causal interventions connect internal features with observable model behavior. The findings distinguish information that is decodable from signals actually used for decisions, enabling targeted audits of language and multimodal systems.

topics.name: Robust multimodal representation learning
topics.summary: Multimodal representations are trained to discount unstable visual cues while preserving semantic or brain-relevant information. Caption-factor separation and adversarially robust CLIP targets improve alignment and reveal links between robustness and downstream neural decoding.

topics.name: AI safety verification and generalization
topics.summary: Safety evaluations construct controlled failures, interactive checks, and distribution shifts to separate training success from deployment reliability. The studies examine conditional behavior mixtures and efficient proof protocols for verifying claims without relying solely on a competing model.

topics.name: Specialized natural language processing
topics.summary: Language models and classifiers structure legal arguments, sentiment aspects, cancer records, and scholarly documents. Domain annotations, citation or human checks, weak labels, and calibration reveal useful extraction gains alongside failures from imbalance, noise, and context.

topics.name: Software reliability and neural-network verification
topics.summary: Runtime traces, redundant generated implementations, and semidefinite robustness certificates provide complementary checks on software and learned models. The methods target architectural mismatches, correlated failures, and faster certification of safety properties.

topics.name: Immersive-media compression and quality assessment
topics.summary: Light-field and dynamic point-cloud systems combine codec design with subjective and objective quality measurements. View synthesis, motion distortions, and temporal geometry expose weaknesses in current metrics while enabling lower attribute bitrate.

topics.name: Human-centered visual communication
topics.summary: Visualization onboarding and scientific-poster generation are evaluated with user studies, communication constraints, provenance checks, and artifact-quality measures. Guidance and layout support improve usability when automation remains accountable to the intended audience.
